beats.summary: Michael and colleagues go house to house to give Dundie Nomination Certificates.

evidence.snippet: Michael: It is six a.m. and we are about to go house to house to give everyone their Dundie Nomination Certificates.

beats.summary: Stanley reacts negatively to the Dundie visit, telling Michael to leave.

evidence.snippet: Stanley: Have you lost your mind! Get off my property before I call the police!

beats.summary: Michael encounters Meredith, who is leaving her house and excited about her nomination.

evidence.snippet: Meredith: Ahh, Nice! I got a Dundie nomination!
Michael: Yes you did. That's right! Congratulations Meredith.

beats.summary: Michael announces the Dundies event and discusses its significance.

evidence.snippet: Michael: The Dundies are my baby, and they need to go on.

beats.summary: Michael decides to have a co-host for the Dundies, choosing DeAngelo.

evidence.snippet: Michael: So as you know, the Dundies are my legacy. So I'm going to need to train a replacement. So this year, I have decided to have a co-host. And that person is DeAngelo!

beats.summary: Michael and DeAngelo practice hosting, with DeAngelo expressing doubt about his performance.

evidence.snippet: Deangelo: Thank you Michael, uh, but I will have to pass.
Deangelo: Not much of a performer, unless you count singing in the shower.
